queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Dell Command %Update' AND publisher = 'Dell Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Dell Command %Update' AND publisher = 'Dell Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '5.7.2') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('dellcommandupdate.exe','dcu-cli.exe'));
